title.narrative: Regional Cooperation Mechanism for Solutions to the Central African Republic Displacement Situation: CAR Solutions Support Platform (CAR-SSP)

description.narrative:
The principal objective of the action is to implement the Recommendations of the Yaoundé Declaration through the implementation of the CAR-SSP.

To reach this objective, two sub-objectives have been identified, namely:

Sub-Objective A: To establish and empower a regional institutional framework, with the support of the international community.

Sub-Objective B: Within the regional cooperation framework, to channel policy dialogues in favour of the implementation of the commitments of the Yaoundé Declaration.
